# partiteai_workspace (Data Source)

Workspace data source. Look up a workspace by `id` or by `name` (exactly one must be set).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Workspace identifier. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Workspace name. Names are unique. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was created
- `scope` (String) Lifetime and visibility of the workspace. One of `GLOBAL` or `CONVERSATION`.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the resource was last updated
